title: App Navigation
subtitle: Three destinations, and everything branches off them.

hero.alt: The TournaQ home screen with its three top-level destinations

intro: The home screen splits the app into three: TournaQ Arena for every game and tournament, Administration for players, teams and groups, and More for everything alongside them.

Every route follows the same shape — a top-level destination, then a hub, then the detail, and back the same way. No hidden paths and no dead ends, which matters when you are holding a phone in one hand at the side of a court.
bestfor: Getting oriented before running your first session
Finding a screen you have seen once and cannot place
Knowing what lives where before you need it mid-match

sections.title: Opening the app
sections.text: Two screens between launching TournaQ and choosing what to run.

cards.p: TournaQ Arena, Administration and More. Three cards, and everything in the app sits under one of them.
cards.alt: The TournaQ home screen with Arena, Administration and More

cards.p: Below the three destinations sit the shortcuts to whatever you were last doing, so a session in progress is one tap from launch.
cards.alt: The full home screen including shortcuts to recent activity

sections.title: The Arena
sections.text: Every format the app can run, grouped by the kind of session it suits — and everything you have already run, underneath.

cards.p: Quick Games at the top, then Single Competitions & Socials where you enter as a player, then Team Competitions. The number on a card is how many of those you have run.
cards.alt: The TournaQ Arena listing every format grouped into three categories

cards.p: The same screen carries your tournament history, grouped by mode with a count against each, so a previous event is a couple of taps away.
cards.alt: The full Arena screen with the format cards above the tournament history

cards.p: Pick a mode and the history narrows to it — the fastest route back into something you ran last month.
cards.alt: Tournament history filtered to a single mode

sections.title: Finding an old event
sections.text: Nothing is deleted when a session ends. Every tournament stays on the device with all its results.

cards.p: The full list across every mode, with the date, the player or team count and how far each got. Completed and in-progress events sit together, marked.
cards.alt: The full tournament history listing events across every mode

cards.p: The other top-level destination: players, teams and groups saved once and reused in every format. It has its own page here.
cards.alt: The Administration screen with players, teams and groups

sections.title: Everything else
sections.text: The screens that sit beside the main flow — settings, contact, and the things you look at once.

cards.p: Contact & About, Sponsoring & Promo, and Settings. The screens you need occasionally, kept out of the way of the ones you need mid-match.
cards.alt: The More screen listing Contact, Sponsoring and Settings

cards.p: Four language options — Automatic, English, Deutsch, Español — and a Privacy Options link for managing ad consent.
cards.alt: The Settings screen with language options and privacy controls

cards.p: Social links, support channels, the legal documents and the app version, in one place.
cards.alt: The Contact and About screen with support links and the app version

cards.p: Advertising and partnership options, for clubs and events that want to put their name on a session.
The route into the beta, for people who want the next formats before they ship.
Where a format that is not built yet takes you, so the Arena never has a card that does nothing.
cards.alt: The Coming Soon screen shown for formats not yet built

feedback: Lost in the app, or think a screen should be somewhere else? Tell us where you looked.
